bases.ucits: UCITS proxy: 5-weekday tranche, lag 2, 15 bps Nasdaq sleeve, 8 bps IEF/bills/gold

bootstrap.sign: diff = first - second; for ulcer a negative diff means the first is better

meta.planning_rule: CAGR/Calmar range = min..max over IS88/IS00/IS07 point estimates on the route basis (US='us', UCITS='ucits'); maxDD = realized IS88 + bootstrap median and 5th pct (L=252, IS88). No Friday-basis number used.

metric_defs.top5dd_mean: mean depth of the 5 deepest distinct peak-to-new-high drawdown episodes
metric_defs.cdar95: mean of the worst ceil(5% x n) daily drawdown observations
metric_defs.pct_neg_years: share of COMPLETE calendar years in the window with a negative return
metric_defs.ex_sharpe: mean(r - rf_d)/std(r - rf_d, ddof 1) x sqrt(252)

data_caveats: spx in the panel is the S&P 500 PRICE index (1988-2025 CAGR 9.1%); the 60/40 benchmark omits equity dividends. A total-return fetch (^SP500TR) failed: no network in this sandbox.
qqq before 1999-03-10 is NDX price return - 0.20%/yr (no dividends); qld/tqqq before inception are simulations (2x/3x NDX - 0.95% - financing at T-bill).
gold_phys before 2000-08-30 is a monthly-average log-interpolation (return sleeve only, never a signal).
ief/tlt/shy before 2002-07-30 are calibrated synthetics; bills before 2007-05-30 = T-bill - 0.13%/yr.

critic_reproduction.tolerance_note: critic JSON values are rounded to 5 decimals, so |diff| <= 5e-6 means exact reproduction
